Name: Custom egg amount to win the Egg Festival
Author: onlythechosen
Description:
[size=3]This mod allows you to set a custom amount of eggs needed to win the egg festival.  The default amount needed to win in the vanilla game is 9.  With this mod you can set it to a lower or higher number.[/size]

[size=4][b]Only works with SDV 1.6[/b][/size]

[b][size=4]How to install:

[/size][/b][size=3]> Unzip the file and put it into your mod folder ( Stardew Valley -> Content -> Mods )
> Make sure you have the latest version of SMAPI installed (at least 4.0.0)[/size]

[b][size=4]Configuration Options (config.json):

[/size][size=3] [/size][/b][size=3] "Enabled": true, // Enable the mod
  "NumberOfEggs": 5 // Number of eggs needed to win the egg festival
[/size]
